command:
set -eu
. /etc/os-release
test "$ID" = ubuntu
test "$VERSION_ID" = 16.04
kernel="$(uname -r)"
printf '%s\n' "$kernel" | grep -Eq '^4\.4\.'
grep -qw 'net.ifnames=0' /proc/cmdline
test -d /sys/class/net/eth0
test -d /sys/class/net/eth1
printf '%s:%s kernel=%s interfaces=eth0,eth1 net.ifnames=0\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID" "$kernel"

set -eu
. /etc/os-release
test "$ID" = ubuntu
test "$VERSION_ID" = 24.04
kernel="$(uname -r)"
printf '%s\n' "$kernel" | grep -Eq '^6\.'
! grep -qw 'net.ifnames=0' /proc/cmdline
interfaces="$(ip -o -4 addr show scope global | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$interfaces" | grep -c .)" -eq 2
if printf '%s\n' "$interfaces" | grep -Ev '^enp[0-9]+s[0-9]+$' | grep -q .; then
  exit 1
fi
backend=not-installed
if command -v iptables >/dev/null; then
  iptables -V | grep -q 'nf_tables'
  backend=nf_tables
fi
printf '%s:%s kernel=%s interfaces=%s backend=%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID" "$kernel" "$(printf '%s\n' "$interfaces" | paste -sd, -)" "$backend"

set -eu
sudo -n find /opt/legacy-netapp /etc/legacy-netapp -xdev -type f -print | sort | sudo -n xargs sha256sum
sudo -n sha256sum /usr/local/libexec/legacy-netapp-start /usr/local/sbin/legacy-netapp-firewall /etc/systemd/system/legacy-netapp-firewall.service /etc/systemd/system/legacy-netapp@.service
sudo -n stat -c '%U:%G:%a:%n' /var/lib/legacy-netapp/site-id /etc/legacy-netapp/netapp.conf /opt/legacy-netapp/edge-echo.py

set -eu
systemctl is-active legacy-netapp-firewall.service
systemctl is-enabled legacy-netapp-firewall.service
systemctl is-active legacy-netapp@1.service
systemctl is-enabled legacy-netapp@1.service
systemctl is-active legacy-netapp@2.service
systemctl is-enabled legacy-netapp@2.service
service_ip="$(ip -o -4 addr show dev eth1 scope global | awk 'NR == 1 {split($4, a, "/"); print a[1]}')"
sudo -n ss -lnpt 'sport = :4180' | grep "$service_ip:4180"

set -eu
default_if="$(ip -4 route show default | awk 'NR == 1 {print $5}')"
service_if="$(ip -o -4 addr show scope global | awk -v default_if="$default_if" '$2 != default_if {print $2; exit}')"
test "$(curl --noproxy '*' --interface "$service_if" --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 -fsS http://legacy-netapp.service.lan:4180/health)" = legacy-netapp-ok
test "$(curl --noproxy '*' --interface "$service_if" --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 -fsS http://legacy-netapp.service.lan:4180/identity)" = migration-cohort-44

set -eu
default_if="$(ip -4 route show default | awk 'NR == 1 {print $5}')"
service_if="$(ip -o -4 addr show scope global | awk -v default_if="$default_if" '$2 != default_if {print $2; exit}')"
responses=''
for attempt in $(seq 1 80); do
  response="$(curl --noproxy '*' --interface "$service_if" --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 -fsS http://legacy-netapp.service.lan:4180/worker)"
  responses="${responses}${response}\n"
done
printf '%b' "$responses" | sort -u | grep -qx 'worker=1'
printf '%b' "$responses" | sort -u | grep -qx 'worker=2'

set -eu
iptables -V | grep -vq 'nf_tables'
bind_address="$(ip -o -4 addr show dev eth1 scope global | awk 'NR == 1 {split($4, a, "/"); print a[1]}')"
source_cidr="$(ip -4 route show dev eth1 scope link | awk '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\/[0-9]+$/ {print $1; exit}')"
test -n "$bind_address"
test -n "$source_cidr"
sudo -n iptables -C INPUT -p tcp --dport 4180 -j LEGACY_NETAPP
sudo -n iptables -C LEGACY_NETAPP -p tcp --dport 4180 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
sudo -n iptables -C LEGACY_NETAPP -p tcp --dport 4180 -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
sudo -n iptables -C LEGACY_NETAPP -i eth1 -s "$source_cidr" -d "$bind_address" -p tcp --dport 4180 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -m limit --limit 120/second --limit-burst 240 -j ACCEPT
sudo -n iptables -C LEGACY_NETAPP -p tcp --dport 4180 -m limit --limit 6/minute --limit-burst 10 -j LOG --log-prefix 'legacy-netapp-deny '
sudo -n iptables -C LEGACY_NETAPP -p tcp --dport 4180 -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset

set -eu
cat /sys/module/apparmor/parameters/enabled
systemctl is-active apparmor.service || true
systemctl is-enabled ssh.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl is-enabled ssh.socket 2>/dev/null || true

set -eu
cat /sys/module/apparmor/parameters/enabled
systemctl is-active apparmor.service || true
systemctl is-enabled ssh.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl is-enabled ssh.socket 2>/dev/null || true

set -eu
! id legacy-netapp >/dev/null 2>&1
test ! -e /opt/legacy-netapp
test ! -e /etc/legacy-netapp
! sudo -n ss -lnpt 'sport = :4180' | grep -q ':4180'
